 Skincare, Makeup, and More: Shop This Local Brand’s Beauty Bestsellers at Up to 75% Off This 11.11
 Deals 
 November 11, 2026 
 Regine Tan 
 A good makeup routine often comes down to finding products that work well together. A complexion product that offers the coverage you prefer, a powder to help manage shine, and a lip color you can wear from day to night can all become regular parts of your makeup bag. For those interested in discovering more homegrown beauty labels, Popique is one local brand worth getting to know. 
 The Filipino makeup and skincare brand brings both categories together through a range of products, including multi-purpose complexion pots, cream palettes, and peptide-infused lip care. Its colorful packaging also reflects its beach-inspired identity and approach to beauty. 
 This 11.11, Popique is offering up to 75% off. We’ve rounded up some of the brand’s beauty bestsellers worth checking out during the sale. 
 1. Popique Overtime Setting Spray 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 A setting spray does more than add a final mist to your makeup routine. Popique’s Overtime Setting Spray is formulated to help set makeup and maintain a fresh-looking finish throughout the day.  
 Its formula includes niacinamide, trehalose, and vitamin E, ingredients commonly used in skincare for their skin-conditioning and antioxidant properties. It also contains rose flower water and witch hazel water. If you like finishing your makeup with a spray, this is one product to consider adding to your routine. BUY IT HERE! 
 2. Popique Face Forward Multi-Complexion Pot [Conceal + Cover] 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 A multi-purpose complexion product can be useful when you want to get more out of a single makeup item. Popique’s Face Forward Multi-Complexion Pot [Conceal + Cover] is designed to work as a spot concealer, foundation, under-eye brightener, and contour product, depending on the shade and how you apply it. Its creamy formula offers buildable coverage with a skin-like finish, so you can start with a small amount and add more where needed.  
 The ingredient list also includes meadowfoam seed oil, castor seed oil, and silica. Each pot contains 5 grams of product, and you can apply it with your fingers, a brush, or a sponge. BUY IT HERE! 
 3. Popique Face Forward Multi-Complexion Pot [Brighten + Correct] 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 For the under-eye area, the Face Forward Multi-Complexion Pot [Brighten + Correct] offers a targeted approach to complexion makeup. Its peach-toned shades are designed to help counter the appearance of dark circles and discoloration before applying concealer.  
 The formula includes jojoba seed oil, sodium hyaluronate, vitamin E, and ascorbic acid, alongside emollients that give the product its creamy consistency. Apply a small amount around the under-eye area and gently tap it into the skin before layering your concealer. This is a useful option for anyone who wants to add color correction to their base makeup routine. BUY IT HERE! 
 4. Popique Set & Smooth Baked Powder 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 If you prefer setting your makeup with powder, the Popique Set & Smooth Baked Powder offers the convenience of a pressed compact with the lightweight feel of a loose powder. Its formula contains silica and corn starch, which help absorb excess oil, while its soft-blur finish is designed to reduce the appearance of texture.  
 The powder is also non-comedogenic. Its translucent shade has an added brightening effect, making it an option for setting your base without adding another layer of noticeable color. Apply it with a fluffy brush or powder puff, concentrating on your T-zone and other areas that tend to get shiny. BUY IT HERE! 
 5. Popique Kiss Me Multi-Peptide Lip Balm 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 For lip color that comes with a little extra care, the Popique Kiss Me Multi-Peptide Lip Balm combines a sheer tint with a glossy finish. Its formula features two peptides, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-8 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, alongside vitamin E. These ingredients give the balm its skincare-inspired formula, while the buildable pigment lets you control how much color you want on your lips.  
 Wear a single swipe for a subtle tint or layer it for a more noticeable finish. It also has a non-sticky texture and comes in a 10 ml tube, making it an easy product to bring along for everyday use. BUY IT HERE! 
 6. Popique So Comfy Blur Lipstick 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 If you usually reach for matte lip colors, the Popique So Comfy Blur Lipstick offers a softer take on the classic lipstick finish. Its lightweight formula is designed to create a blurred, soft-focus effect on the lips, with pigment that you can build by layering.  
 The formula includes dimethicone for a smooth, silky feel, along with silica and kaolin, which contribute to its matte finish. Apply it directly to clean, dry lips and blend the edges for a diffused look. You can also add another layer when you want a more pronounced lip color. Each lipstick contains 3 grams of product. BUY IT HERE! 
 7. Popique All-Over Multiuse Cream Palette 
 Photo: Popique Beauty
 For a more coordinated makeup look, the Popique All-Over Multiuse Cream Palette brings together three cream shades in one compact. Each palette features two matte shades and one shimmer, all designed for use on the cheeks, eyes, and lips. You can apply one of the matte shades across different areas for a monochromatic look, mix the two colors to create another shade, or use the shimmer to add dimension.  
 Its ingredient list includes skin-conditioning ingredients such as castor seed oil and sodium hyaluronate, with select shades also featuring ingredients like grape seed oil and pomegranate extract. The palette contains 5.4 grams of product and can be applied using your fingers or a makeup brush. BUY IT HERE! 
 From complexion makeup and setting products to lip color and multi-use palettes, Popique has several options for building out your beauty collection.  
 Shop Popique on Shopee .
